_note: Written by hand: acceptance criteria for the six tasks of fixtures/llm/task_breakdown.json, by the id the stage gives each task. The test answers each epic's call with the criteria of the tasks it was sent.

task_001.when: a group with one expense of 300 is saved
task_001.then: reading the group back returns the same expense of 300
it is returned with an empty expense list

task_002.given: a payment the provider reports as failed after the debit
task_002.then: a refund is started and the payment shows as refunded

task_002.given: a failed payment whose refund request is rejected by the provider
task_002.then: the payment shows as refund pending and the refund is tried again within an hour

task_003.given: a payment that the provider confirms
task_003.then: the group shows the payment as completed

task_003.given: a payment whose confirmation arrives twice
task_003.then: the payment is still shown once, as completed

task_003.given: a payment with no answer from the provider for 10 minutes
task_003.then: the payment shows as pending with the time it was started

task_004.given: a user who has started a payment
task_004.then: no full-screen ad was shown between the start and the result screen

task_004.given: an ad that was already loading when the payment started
task_004.then: it is not shown until the payment result has been dismissed

task_005.given: a user whose verification code has not arrived after 60 seconds
task_005.when: they choose to log in by email link and open the link
task_005.then: they are logged in to their account

task_005.given: an email link that is older than 15 minutes
task_005.then: they see that the link has expired and can request a new one

task_006.given: a group of three where A owes B 100 and B owes C 100
task_006.then: A is asked to pay C 100 and the group shows no balances afterwards

task_006.given: a group in which nobody owes anything
task_006.then: they see that the group is settled and no payment is offered
